purpose: Synthetic, manually specified contrast set. These are NOT real publications. Expected labels never enter production prompts or model inputs. Real provider validation is recorded separately.
query: Je cherche des méthodes entraînées qui produisent un maillage volumique 3D avec connectivité pour le calcul mécanique. Privilégie la génération effective, pas seulement une surface, un maillage 2D, la prédiction de champs ou l'adaptation d'un maillage existant. Explique les exclusions sans imposer de tags.

records.title: Neural mesh generation for mechanical simulation: volumetric elements
records.abstract: A trained generative network produces tetrahedral vertices and element connectivity from a prescribed solid geometry. Experiments evaluate element inversion and finite element convergence in three-dimensional linear elasticity.

records.title: Neural mesh generation for mechanical simulation: surface reconstruction
records.abstract: A trained network reconstructs triangular boundary surfaces from images. No volume elements or interior connectivity are generated. Experiments measure visual surface distance.

records.title: Neural mesh generation for mechanical simulation: planar domains
records.abstract: The model generates triangular elements on two-dimensional planar domains. Training and validation cover planar Poisson problems only. No volumetric three-dimensional discretization is produced.

records.title: Neural mesh generation for mechanical simulation: graph field prediction
records.abstract: Despite the title, the method consumes an existing three-dimensional mesh and predicts stress and displacement fields using a graph neural network. It does not generate mesh nodes or connectivity.

records.title: Automatic volumetric mesh generation for mechanical simulation
records.abstract: A deterministic Delaunay algorithm creates tetrahedral meshes for arbitrary solids. No model is trained; no neural network or learned component is used. Element quality and finite element accuracy are evaluated.

records.title: Neural mesh generation for mechanical simulation: adaptation
records.abstract: A reinforcement learning policy moves vertices of an existing tetrahedral mesh to improve quality. Connectivity is fixed. The method requires a supplied mesh and never constructs an initial volumetric mesh.

records.title: Neural mesh generation for mechanical simulation: solid decomposition
records.abstract: A learned classifier partitions a CAD solid into blocks. The contribution stops at geometric decomposition: it does not create volumetric mesh connectivity or validate the resulting discretization. Meshing is left to future downstream work.
